name: Durban
tagline: Warm Indian Ocean beaches and the best curry outside India
summary: Durban is South Africa's warm-water surf city, with a long Golden Mile promenade and a strong Indian heritage. Eat a bunny chow, see the uShaka Marine World aquarium, walk or swing at Moses Mabhida Stadium and head inland to the Valley of a Thousand Hills and the Drakensberg.
seasonNote: Winter is warm and dry, perfect for beaches; summer is hot and humid.
arrival: King Shaka International is 35 minutes north.
gettingAround: Uber and taxis; walk the beachfront promenade.
cashTip: Cards and tap-to-pay work almost everywhere; carry small rand notes for car guards and tips.
buyTip: Spices at the Victoria Street Market.
